notes.title: Achievements Unlocked for Assassin's Creed Liberation!
notes.content:
[h2]🔓 Achievements Unlocked! 🔓[/h2]

[h3] It’s time to put your Assassin skills to the test as Steam achievements are now available for Assassin’s Creed Liberation. [/h3]

Step into the shoes of Aveline de Grandpré, a deadly assassin who will use every weapon and ability in her arsenal on her quest for freedom. Uncover the hidden secrets of New Orleans while earning achievements along the way. Whether you're mastering combat, exploring the world, or uncovering hidden truths, there’s plenty to unlock!

[i][b]Achievements will be retroactively earned for those accomplishments already completed in your journey.[/b][/i]
